items.source: Separate parts of the path may be separated by "." or by "_" or by camel case. When the match to properties is ambiguous longer property names are preferred. So for userAddressCity the interpretation userAddress.city is preferred over user.address.city.
items.translation: 路径的各个部分可以通过 `"."`、`"_"` 或驼峰命名法分隔。当属性匹配存在歧义时，优先选择更长的属性名。因此，对于 `userAddressCity`，解释为 `userAddress.city` 优于 `user.address.city`。

items.source: Returns the actual type of the property at this segment. Will return the plain resolved type for simple properties, the component type for any Iterable or the value type of Map properties.
items.translation: 返回此段属性上的实际类型。对于简单属性，将返回解析后的基本类型；对于任何 Iterable 或 Map 属性的值类型，将返回组件类型。

items.source:
Returns an Iterator of PropertyPath that iterates over all property path segments. For example: 
PropertyPath path = PropertyPath.from("address.city.name", Person.class);
path.forEach(p -> p.toDotPath());
results in the dot paths: 
address.city.name     (this object)
city.name             (next() object)
name             (next().next() object)
items.translation:
返回一个PropertyPath 的 Iterator，用于遍历所有属性路径段。例如： 
PropertyPath path = PropertyPath.from("address.city.name", Person.class);
path.forEach(p -> p.toDotPath());
生成的点表示路径如下： 
address.city.name     (当前对象)
city.name             (next() 对象)
name             (next().next() 对象)

items.source:
Returns the next PropertyPath segment in the property path chain. 
PropertyPath.from("address.city.name", Person.class).next().toDotPath();
results in the output: city.name.
items.translation:
返回属性路径链中的下一个 PropertyPath 段。 
PropertyPath.from("address.city.name", Person.class).next().toDotPath();
结果为输出：city.name。
